spec.formula: loop_filter_h_sb128uv_c / loop_filter_v_sb128uv_c and loop_filter() in context/reference_loopfilter_tmpl.c: for each 4-pixel block j < w whose bit is set in mask[0] (wd 4) or mask[1] (wd 6), with level L from lvl (0 = skip), E = lut->e[L], I = lut->i[L], H = L >> 4, compute fm (filter mask from |p1-p0|, |q1-q0|, |p0-q0|*2+|p1-q1|/2 against I and E), flat (wd 6) and hev, then the narrow (4-tap) or 6-tap filter exactly as the C, per pixel line
